gaps.title: Lack of Dedicated End-to-End Cold Chain IoT Monitoring Platform
gaps.detail: While Radhakrishna Foodland utilizes advanced inventory management technologies, they lack a specified IoT-driven real-time temperature, humidity, and location tracking solution across their 30+ distribution centers and transit assets.
gaps.based_on: The company describes using 'advanced inventory management technologies' for real-time visibility and control, claiming 99.8%+ inventory accuracy, though it does not name a specific IoT or monitoring platform.

gaps.title: Fleet & Asset Monitoring Across Expanded Multi-Temperature Transport Assets
gaps.detail: Managing 600+ multi-temperature transport assets across India and the Middle East requires unified real-time location, temp deviation alerts, and asset protection hardware to feed into their control tower.
gaps.based_on: Radhakrishna Foodland runs 600+ multi-temperature transport assets and reports a 99% on-time delivery performance rate.

gaps.title: Automated Multi-Zone Compliance Logging for FSSAI and BRCGS Audits
gaps.detail: Maintaining ambient, tropical, chilled, and frozen storage across 2M+ sq ft requires automated sensor logging and instant excursion alerts to simplify FSSAI and BRCGS audit record-keeping.
gaps.based_on: Warehousing covers frozen, chilled, tropical, and ambient storage, and the operation is BRCGS certified and FSSAI compliant for food safety.

pitch.angle: As Radhakrishna Foodland scales its Middle East operations and advances its 2024 Foodland Operating System control tower, GND's ThinxFresh IoT platform can provide the underlying real-time temperature, humidity, and asset trackers needed for 600+ multi-temp assets and 30+ DCs. This integration ensures seamless FSSAI and BRCGS audit-ready digital traceability without replacing existing inventory software.
pitch.opener: With Radhakrishna Foodland expanding across the Middle East and launching its control tower, are you looking for real-time IoT temperature and asset tracking to stream directly into your Foodland Operating System across your 600+ multi-temp assets?
